answer: An admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch offers 200 slots; applicants post sealed bids, and the top 200 win entry, marked by an umber seal. An attacker wanting 500 fakes must outbid applicants 500 times: at 40 credits each, that is 20,000 credits locked for 20 epochs, widening like a delta. Honest agents pay once, recover it in 6 epochs, and keep undiluted rewards; a zephyr of newcomers must pay the same price to displace them.
